text:
The most recent Republican to win a New York gubernatorial election was **George Pataki**, who was elected in 1994.  
On the ballot he appeared under **two party lines**:

| Party line | Caption on ballot |
|------------|-------------------|
| Republican Party (NY) | “Republican” |
| Conservative Party of New York | “Conservative” |

Pataki’s 1994 nomination was also endorsed by the Conservative Party – a cross‑endorsement that is common in New York state elections.  As a result, voters had the option to vote for him under either the “Republican” or the “Conservative” ballot lines, and the combined total from both lines contributed to his victory.
